chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Topa in Noah kiangah, “Nang leh na innkuanpihte khempeuh teembaw sungah pai un, bang hang hiam cih leh nang in hih khang mite' sung panin a thuman na hihna ka mu khin hi.
Ganhing siangtho kop sagih, a nu leh a pa, ganhing a siang lote kop khat, a nu leh a pa;
huih lak vasate zong kop sagih, a nu leh a pa, lei maitang tung khempeuh ah amau’ nam a man’than’ loh nadingin la in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ni sagih sungin sun sawmli leh zan sawmli sung leitungah guah ka zusak ding hi; ka bawlsa nuntakna a nei peuhmah lei maitang panin ka phiatkhia ding hi,” ci hi.
Noah in Topa ’ thupiak khempeuh hih hi.
Leitungah tuiciin a tun’in, Noah kum zaguk pha hi.
Tuiciin pelh dingin Noah, a tapate, a zi leh a tapate’ zite teembaw sungah pai uh hi.
Ganhing siangthote, a siangtho lo ganhingte, vasate, leitunga a bokvak peuhmah,
nih nih-in, a nu leh a pa, Pasian in Noah a thu piaksa bangin teembaw sungah Noah tawh pai uh hi.
Ni sagih khit cianginleitungah tuiciin tung hi.
Noah’ nuntak kum zaguk kum, a kha nihna, tua kha ni sawm-le-sagih ni-in van-a om a thuk mahmah tuikhukte puakkhamin, vantung kongvangneute kihong hi.
Sun sawmli leh zan sawmli sung leitungah guah zu hi.
Tua ni teekteekin Noah leh a tapate, Shem, Ham, Jafeth leh Noah’ zi leh a tapate’ zi thumte, amaute tawh teembaw sungah tum uh hi.
Amaute leh gamsa peuhmah ama' nam ciat, leitungah a bokvak peuhmah ama' nam ciat, leh vasa peuhmah, ama' nam ciat, vasa namkim ama' nam ciatin tum uh hi.
Nuntak husan’na a nei khempeuh nih nihin Noah tawh teembaw sungah pai uh hi.
Pasian’ thupiaksa bangin nuntakna a nei khempeuh teembaw sungah a lut khit ciangin Topa in amah kong khaknelh hi.
Leitungah tuiciin ni sawmli sung om den hi; tui tam semsem a, teembaw laamto-in, leitung' tungah khangin sang to hi.
Tui khang to-in leitungah tam mahmah hi; tui tungah teembaw laam hi.
Leitungah tui khangkhang ahih manin van buppi nuai-a mual lian a sangte khempeuh tuumcip hi;
mual liante tungah tui om a, amau tungah tong sawm-le-nga thukin tuam hi.
Leitunga a nungta khempeuh, vasate, innsate, gamsate, a hon honin leitungah a hon om ganhingte khempeuh leh mi khempeuh si uh hi;
leikeu tunga a om, a nak sungah nuntakna hu a om peuhmah si hi.

Mihing, ganhing, a bokvakte leh huih lak vasate, lei maitang tunga om nuntakna a nei peuhmah amah in phiatkhia hi; leitung panin amaute kiphiatkhia hi. Noah leh amah tawh teembaw sunga a om teng bek suakta hi.
Ni za leh ni sawmnga sung leitungah tui om hi.
